blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Alex Eala won’t be making her much-awaited debut in the Singapore Open main draw until Wednesday night. But Filipino fans will have someone to root for as early as Monday night when Leylah Fernandez hits center court at OCBC Arena here. Fernandez, born and raised in Montreal, Canada, but also proud of her Filipino roots, will also draw support from Filipinos, who are expected to be in full force when Eala begins her campaign in the Lion City.
